'''Attack plan ''Vozburk''''' was a combat tactic performed by the [[S'kytri]] warriors led by [[Aragh]] during their [[Battle of Skye|attack]] on [[Zeta Magnus]]'s [[Kharys' fortress|citadel]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Skye/Legends|Skye]]. ''[[Vozburk]]'' was an archaic [[S'kytric]] term for all-out war between the S'kytri and the ground-dwelling demons of Skye. A master geneticist, Magnus previously turned the [[Outland Clan]] of S'kytri into [[Zombie/Legends|zombie]]-like creatures and tasked them with protecting his fortress.
